source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.when: [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), before its Reinforcements step.
parts.target: A **DEATH GUARD CHARACTER** unit of yours that leads no unit.
parts.effect: Pick another **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours, up to 2" from the unit horizontally and up to 5" vertically, that its datasheet's [Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader) section lets it lead. It cannot be a [Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) unit, or an [Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units) that already has 2 Leader units or is led by a **CHARACTER** unit of yours. The unit joins that unit as its Leader; update the **Starting Strength** of the combined unit to match.
